subject.title: [Feature]: Discord - auto-inject @mention for guild message replies

question: Should Discord add a default-off `channels.discord.autoMentionReply` policy that prefixes the original guild reply author's mention when reply text lacks it?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the change intentionally expands Discord config and changes notification behavior for multi-agent guilds, which needs maintainer product judgment before implementation.

options.title: Approve scoped opt-in after live proof
options.body: Implement a default-off Discord-plugin option only after a live guild before/after proof and tests cover duplicate mention, broadcast, DM, and chunking safety.

options.title: Decline automatic mention injection
options.body: Keep native reply references and explicit `mentionAliases`/`<@id>` usage as the supported notification model without adding a new config key.

options.title: Defer for more evidence
options.body: Keep this issue open until a reporter or maintainer provides a live guild reproduction showing the notification gap and expected product behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped opt-in after live proof
recommendation.body: Implement a default-off Discord-plugin option only after a live guild before/after proof and tests cover duplicate mention, broadcast, DM, and chunking safety.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the current outbound mention alias surface and is the strongest current-history owner for deciding whether to expand it.
